data.name: Stefanos
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'stéphanos', meaning 'crown' or 'wreath'. In Christian tradition, the name Stefanos is associated with the martyr Saint Stephen, who was stoned to death and wore a crown of martyrdom.

in_hebrew.name: שטפנוס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שטפנוס  הוא  שמות   אדם  שמקורו  בעברית  וביוונית.  על  פי  המסורת,  שטפנוס  היה  נצר  ואחד  מהשליחים  של  ישו.  השם  נעשה  נפוץ  בעקבות  הפצת  הנצרות  בביזנטיון  ובעבר  הקרוב.  בעבר  הקרוב,  שטפנוס  היה  שם  נפוץ  בקרב  העולים  לישראל  ובקרב  היהודים  בעולם.  השם  נחשב  לאחד  השמות  היפים  והפופולריים  בעולם העברי  ובקרב  העולים  לישראל.

in_greek.name: Στεφανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Στεφανός  είναι  το  όνομα  που  προέρχεται  από  την  ελληνική  γλώσσα.  Ο  Στεφανός  ήταν  ένας  από  τους  12  μαθητές  του  Ιησού.  Ο  Στεφανός  ήταν  ένας  από  τους  πρωταγωνιστές  στην  ιστορία  της  Primitive  Church  και  έγινε  ο  πρώτος  μάρτυρας  του  Χριστιανισμού.  Ο  Στεφανός  ήταν  η  αρχή  της  κοσμικής  αρχή  του  Στεφάνου,  η  οποία  είναι  ένα  από  τα  πιο  δημοφιλή  ονόματα  στην  Ελλάδα.

in_latin.name: Stefanus
in_latin.long_meaning: Stefanus  est  nomen  quod  ex  lingua  Graeca  deductum  est.  Stephanus  fuit  unus  ex  duodecim  discipulis  Iesu.  Stephanus  fuit  unus  ex  primis  martyribus  Ecclesiae  primitivae  et  factus  est  primus  martyr  Christianorum.  Stephanus  fuit  origo  gloriae  dei,  qui  est  unus  ex  nominibus  maxime  popularibus  in  mundo.

in_english.name: Stefanos
in_english.long_meaning: Stefanos  is  a  name  of  Greek  origin  that  means  'crown  of  glory'.  According  to  Christian  tradition,  Stefanos  was  one  of  Jesus'  twelve  apostles.  He  was  one  of  the  first  martyrs  of  the  Christian  Church  and  is  considered  the  first  Christian  martyr.  The  name  Stefanos  is  derived  from  the  Greek  word  'stephanos,'  meaning  a  wreath  or  a  crown,  and  is  a  popular  name  among  Christians  and  non-Christians  alike.

data.cultural_impact: The name Stefanos is deeply rooted in Greek mythology and culture. The name symbolizes respect, honor, and glory, as a crown or wreath was a sign of victory and achievement in ancient Greece. It is also a popular name throughout Europe, particularly in Eastern Orthodox Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Stefanos holds significant spiritual meaning for Christians, as it is derived from the Greek word 'stéphanos', which represents the crown of martyrdom. This association is most notably linked with Saint Stephen, the first Christian martyr who served as the protodeacon and a member of the Seven Deacons of Jerusalem in early Christian history. The name is therefore a reminder of the ultimate sacrifice and glory in the Christian faith.
